title: 6.7 Modeling with Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

icans: I can tell whether a table shows a linear function, an exponential function, or neither.
I can write an exponential function through two points.
I can use technology to find an exponential model and make predictions.

vocab: equal __________ and equal differences in y: linear
equal x-steps and equal ratios of y: ______________
a _____________ or Desmos model y = abˣ that best fits data

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Linear or exponential?: Constant _______________ → linear. Constant _______________ → exponential.

blocks.stem:

notes: Two points: To find y = abˣ through two points: substitute both points, then _______________ one equation by the other to find b.

blocks.stem: Write an exponential function y = abˣ whose graph passes through (1, 6) and (3, 54).

notes: Exponential regression: In Desmos, exponential regression is typed as _______________.
